title: Ranch Style Dip
summary: Super easy, and far cheaper than a packet with non-food additives.
photoAlt: Sour cream topped with dill, paprika and spices, ready to stir
intro: This is super easy, and much less expensive than a packet that also contains non-food additives. **PLUS**, once you’re comfortable with the basic blend, you can make it your own.
My own additions: a wee bit of cayenne, just enough to barely be tasted, and a bit of paprika, which gives a nice savory base to the bright taste of the dill.

equipment.note: Large enough for the amount you want to make.
For getting the sour cream out of its container.

steps: **Assemble** the spices all in one place.
**Mix** up the spices in a little bowl. Add whatever seems to need more, by smell.

pace.text: Possible stopping point. Make a jar of blend ahead and shake it before using: heavier spices settle.

ingredients.note: to thin sour cream, or a little water to thin yogurt

steps: **Mix** about {qty:2 tbsp} of the blend into the sour cream (or yogurt).

pace.text: Let it sit at least an hour, but no more than 4 hours at room temperature. Room temp is best, so the onion flakes soak up moisture.

steps: **Stir and taste.** A little cayenne gives it a nip; dried chives give a milder, slightly different onion flavor.
**Blend:** equal parts parsley, onion powder, onion flakes or chives, and salt. ½ part garlic powder and black pepper. 2 parts dill.
**Options:** a little cayenne or paprika, added when you make the dip.
**Mix** about {qty:2 tbsp} of blend into {qty:16 oz} sour cream, yogurt, labneh or crème fraîche.
**Rest** at least 30 min. Taste, and add more if wanted.
**Thin** with cream, milk or buttermilk to make a dressing.
keys: Keep a jar of blend; shake before using
